blocks.text: ROTTERDAM–Japan won the men’s team title at the Artistic Gymnastics World Championships in Rotterdam on Tuesday, with Daiki Hashimoto producing a standout display as he helped his country finish ahead of Russia and China. The battle for gold went down to the final of six rotations, with Japan and China separated by a mere one-tenth of a point, while Russia remained in contention, a further half point back. READ: Carlos Yulo advance to vault, floor finals at World Championships Japan prevailed under pressure, thanks in large part to an excellent routine from Hashimoto on the horizontal bar.
